leg_removal_3_to_2.catches: Strategy mutant M14 ('keep the leg rows after the leg count drops') and a mutant that keeps a removed leg's payout in the downline sum: legStudentInputs() and legRows() drop to length 2 and the downline changes 12,015 to 8,010, so both survive states fail.

four_leg_case.catches: A mutant that caps the row list at 3 (slice) — length 4 fails; a mutant that appends a wrong default to the new leg — legStudentInputs()[3] must hold 3; and a mutant that computes the gross from the wrong rate tier — gross 20,744.54 at GV 36,000 excludes the rate(27,000) branch (which gives 14,663.41).
four_leg_case.still_misses: The fourth row's onChange wiring: the test never types into leg 4's input, so a mutant binding row 4's change handler to index 2 passes.

preset_1_full_case.catches: A mutant that maps NETWORK_PRESETS[1] to preset 0's inputs (networkGV would be 12,000, not 24,000); a mutant that drops the tax row or misroutes the label-to-value rows (resultValue reads the dd beside each named dt); a mutant that leaves two presets pressed (pressedPresetCount() must be 1 and indexes 0 and 2 must be aria-pressed false); and stale setup or result text.
preset_1_full_case.still_misses: The preset 1 graph row count: legRows() is not called in this case, and hasFigure() is screen-wide, so it pins that 4,645.69 and 4,506.32 appear somewhere but not which row carries them. The figures themselves depend on the leg inputs, so the money is still pinned.

preset_2_text_case.catches: A mutant that renders preset 0's setup or result text for index 2 — getByText(copy.presets[2].setup) fails because that exact string is absent.
preset_2_text_case.still_misses: Nothing material: preset 2's figures were already pinned by the pre-existing test at lines 203-211, so this case closes the text half of AC-9 only, as prescribed.

clamp_pins.rate_nan_infinity: Catches dropping Number.isFinite from clampNonNegative: Infinity would flow through (Infinity > 0 is true) and commissionRate would return 0.5/0.7, not 0. Still misses a mutant that breaks only NaN handling, because NaN > 0 is already false and the ternary returns 0 either way — the NaN assertion is a pin, not a discriminator.
clamp_pins.infinity_price_and_students: Catches a mutant that lets Infinity through: toSatang(Infinity) throws RangeError, and a mutant that clamps to a large finite value instead of 0 fails the exact networkVolume and gross 0 assertions. Still misses a clamp that maps Infinity to 0 but breaks the leg array only when the array is longer than 2 (untested shape).
clamp_pins.nan_price: Catches a NaN-propagating clamp: NaN would reach toSatang and throw, or fail the exact 0 assertions. Still misses little: behaviorally this case equals price 0; it pins the NaN path rather than discriminating a new mutant.
clamp_pins.nan_leg_entry: Strong case: catches a mutant that drops the NaN leg from the array (legs toEqual fails), one that passes NaN through (students NaN), and one that clamps NaN to 1. Still misses a mutant where clampCount(NaN) is correct but the leg index is 0-based — actually caught by the toEqual leg: 1 shape.
clamp_pins.negative_price_and_count: Catches Math.abs mutants and no-clamp mutants: negative money fields fail expectSafeMoney's non-negative guard, and gross or networkVolume would not be 0. Still misses a Math.max(0, value) mutant without the floor for fractional counts — see nit N2.

mutation_analysis.conservation_guard: expectSafeMoney (tutor-commission.test.ts:254-269) asserts finite, non-negative money on all eight fields and the satang conservation identity; it is only fed cases where legPayouts is 0, so the identity holds on every case it guards. No vacuous pass found.

figure_verification.method: Two independent paths: (1) a from-scratch implementation of the spec 3 formula with the D-3 integer-satang truncation, computed with Code Mode; (2) direct execution of the shipped module with node --experimental-strip-types on the exact inputs the new tests use. Neither used the module's own tests.
figure_verification.leg_drop_3_to_2: price 3,000, own 0, three legs of 3: networkGV 27,000, rate 54.3089%, each leg flat(9,000, 0.445) = 400,500 satang (4,005.00), downline 1,201,500 satang (12,015). Two legs: networkGV 18,000, downline 801,000 satang (8,010). Matches the test pins at test.tsx:167-168 and 174-175.
figure_verification.four_leg_case: GV 36,000: rate 57.6237%, gross satang 2,074,454 (20,744.54), downline 4 x 400,500 = 1,602,000 satang (16,020). Matches the test pins at test.tsx:188-190. Note: the float product rate*GV also rounds to 20,744.54 here, so this pin alone does not discriminate BigInt from float; the 1e9 case at round 1 already carries that discrimination.
figure_verification.clamps: Module execution confirms: commissionRate(NaN) = 0, commissionRate(Infinity) = 0; price NaN, Infinity, and -5 all give all-zero money; personalStudents Infinity and -3 and leg [Infinity] and [-2] give networkVolume 0; leg [NaN] gives {leg:1, students:0, volume:0, payout:0} with networkVolume 12,000. resizeLegs([7,3,3], 2) = [7,3] (first entries kept).
